name: njd-siren-pcb
description: NJD siren + filter PCBs (tscircuit): main board + front board

scripts.check: tsci check netlist index.circuit.tsx && tsci check netlist front.circuit.tsx && bun scripts/check-design-netlist.ts && tsci check placement index.circuit.tsx && tsci check placement front.circuit.tsx && tsci build && bun scripts/check-connectivity.ts dist/index/circuit.json && bun scripts/check-connectivity.ts dist/front/circuit.json && tsci check shorts index.circuit.tsx && tsci check shorts front.circuit.tsx
scripts.fab: mkdir -p fab && tsci export index.circuit.tsx -f gerbers -o fab/njd-siren-main-gerbers.zip && tsci export front.circuit.tsx -f gerbers -o fab/njd-siren-front-gerbers.zip
